versions.changelog:
Initial release of vybes-fun – a Solana token launchpad with integrated prediction markets, AI logo generation, and website builder.

- Launch tokens on Solana instantly via API (no cost, no API key required—wallet address is identity).
- Generate token logos using AI in multiple styles.
- Create and participate in prediction markets for tokens with flexible templates and on-chain SOL betting.
- Build and publish custom token landing pages via aicre8.dev, with automated linking back to Vybes.
- Track all launched tokens, predictions, and earnings in one place.
